findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - running the pull request checks or the release full suite.
`tests/test_affected_own.py:117-126` still requires `timeout-minutes: 45` for every `python_*` smoke job, including `python_starter_smoke`. Changing that job to 60 minutes makes the existing test fail. Update its assertion for this job while retaining the 45-minute expectations for the other Python smoke jobs.
